title: Vietnam trip (Hanoi, Hoi An)
_note: Markers: |S = strong cue (long slot, strong lengthening), |W = weak cue (short pause, weak lengthening); they are never spoken. 'question' is the handoff after a block.

blocks.question: ちなみに、海外で道を渡るのに困ったことってありますか？

blocks.question: 初めて見る料理って、挑戦するほうですか？

blocks.question: 旅行のとき、現地で服や雑貨を買うほうですか？
